fields.Name: T52 - Entity Form View Certification
fields.Description: Verifies that a Certification record opens into its full editable entity form with populated fields, confirming the form rendering pipeline works for the Certifications entity.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to Data Explorer and open the 'Certifications' entity from the entity tree. Click a certification row in the grid, then click the 'Open Full Record' button to load the full certification form in a tab. Reach the state where the form is fully rendered with populated fields. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for loads to finish rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The full Certifications record form is displayed in a tab, not just the grid preview panel
Form fields show populated certification data values
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
